newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 12.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Staff of security firm Codival end week-long pay strike at Ivory Coast's leading company for transport of cash and valuables. - Saturation of Ivorian telephone exchanges because of mounting demand for lines causing degradation of national network, infrastructure minister Ezan Akele tells seminar on telecommunications. - Central Bank of West African States injected 22.7 billion CFA in money tender at rate of 5.0488 percent, meeting demand of all 12 applicants, bank announcement says. - International cosmetics and perfumery fair to take place in Abidjan on May 22 to June 3, advertisement says. - Robbers snatch car and 17 million CFA in cash from Lebanese businessman in Abidjan suburb of Agboville. LA VOIE - More than 10,000 people in western Ivorian town of Guiglo displaced in massive operation by local authorities to pull down shantytowns. LE JOUR - Hysteria over alleged shrinking or disappearing penises blamed on sorcerers spreads to central Ivorian towns of Gagnoa and Divo. Authorities said mobs lynched seven suspected sorcerers in the commercial capital Abidjan last week.
